card.name: Sentence openers after instructions
card.fires_on: The first word of a new sentence or clause right after an instruction, most often "There" in "There|after" following a missed-dose rule. Also linking words like "following", "may", "is" in instruction text.

modes.label: Thereafter after missed dose
modes.description: "There" starting "thereafter" after advice to give a missed dose as soon as possible.
modes.example: If a dose is missed, administer the dose as soon as possible.<< There>>after, resume dosing at the regular

modes.label: Linking word in handling steps
modes.description: A short linking word in device or preparation instructions, such as "following" or "is".
modes.example: Activate (lock) the safety needle shield using one of the<< following>> methods: Surface Activation: Place the needle

card.plain: It marks the start of a follow-on phrase in dosing and injection instructions, especially "thereafter" after a missed dose.
